The filament of a light bulb is assumed to emit radiation as a blackbody at T=2400K. If 12   
the bulb glass has a transmissivity of τ = 0.90 for the radiation emitted by the filament in   
the visible range, calculate the percentage of the total energy emitted by the filament that   
reaches the ambient as visible light.
